name: M3_PDS010MI_AddShiftPatAdj
description: Create shift pattern adjustments for a work center to define which shift pattern applies during a specific date interval. An adjustment links a facility, a work center, a validity period (from date and to date), and a specific shift pattern. This lets you reflect changes such as seasonal patterns or temporary calendar changes without changing the main work center definition. Each adjustment is stored as a separate record and can later be retrieved, updated, or deleted using the related operations.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the work center shift pattern adjustment is created.

inputParameters.name: PLGR
inputParameters.description: Work center for which the shift pattern adjustment is defined.

inputParameters.name: FRDT
inputParameters.description: Start date from which this shift pattern adjustment is valid.

inputParameters.name: TODT
inputParameters.description: End date up to which this shift pattern adjustment is valid.

inputParameters.name: SHPA
inputParameters.description: Shift pattern to be applied for the work center during the adjustment period.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company to which the facility and work center for this shift pattern adjustment belong.

inputParameters.name: CHNO
inputParameters.description: Change number used to track the current version of the shift pattern adjustment record.
